in_sanskrit.name: Makbul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Strong, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Makbul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Makbul is of uncertain origin, but it is believed to derive from the Sanskrit word 'makaranda,' meaning 'strong, powerful,' or 'makara,' meaning 'crocodile.' In Hindu mythology, the crocodile is a symbol of power and strength.
